title: Redex Sim Envelope (shared)
description: The COMMON envelope every Redex sim spec embeds (ledger §E). It carries the cross-cutting contracts that are identical across all six engines: identity + engine kind, the competencies graded, the i18n string-key layer, the xAPI telemetry event contract (with client_event_uuid for idempotent offline sync, ledger §G), the scoring + safety-veto hook (how a sim reports a safety-critical failure that must block a pass, mirroring the DB trigger in 0001_init_academy.sql, ledger §B), and the colorblind-safe state contract (state is ALWAYS encoded by shape + text + color, NEVER color alone — invariant 7). Engine-specific schemas embed this via `$ref` and add only their own interaction model.

engineKind.title: engine_kind
engineKind.description: The runtime that interprets this spec. These values MUST equal the academy.sim_kind Postgres enum values in migrations/0001_init_academy.sql (the column sim_definitions.kind). Do not invent new values here without a migration + typegen (F5b §6).

i18nKey.title: i18n string key
i18nKey.description: A key into the react-i18next string catalog (packages/i18n). NEVER raw display text — all learner-visible strings are keyed so EN+ES (and the non-overridable safety glossary) resolve at render. Convention: 'sim.<sim_id>.<scope>.<name>'.

competencyId.title: competency id
competencyId.description: A UUID referencing academy.competencies(id) — the atomic 'can do X' this sim grades against. Maps into sim_definitions.competency_ids[].

rubricDimension.title: §5.4 rubric dimension
rubricDimension.description: One of the four sign-off rubric dimensions (academy.signoff_dimension). 'safety_compliance' is THE veto dimension: a 0 on a safety-flagged line in this dimension forces a fail (ledger §B).

colorblindSafeState.title: colorblind-safe state token
colorblindSafeState.description: Invariant 7: pass/fail/neutral state is NEVER conveyed by color alone. Every state token a renderer shows must carry a redundant shape + text label alongside any color. This object is the contract the renderer consumes; authors set it (or rely on the framework default tokens) so a colorblind or grayscale-print learner reads the same state. Color is advisory only; `shape` and `label_i18n` are load-bearing.

shape.description: Redundant non-color encoding (the primary signal for colorblind users). E.g. pass=check, fail=cross, warn=triangle, safety_veto=octagon.

label_i18n.description: i18n key for the always-present text label (e.g. 'PASS', 'FAIL', 'SAFETY STOP'). Text is mandatory; never rely on icon alone either.

color_role.description: Advisory color role only (resolved to a WCAG-AA token by the theme). The renderer MUST NOT use this as the sole differentiator.

safetyVetoHook.title: scoring + safety-veto hook
safetyVetoHook.description: How a sim reports a safety-critical failure that MUST block a pass. This is the spec-level mirror of the DB trigger academy.tg_signoff_compute_outcome (ledger §B / invariant 1): a single safety-flagged failure vetoes the whole attempt → outcome 'fail' and sim_attempts.safety_veto_triggered=true, non-overridable, regardless of other points. The shared Verdict service reads this block so veto behavior + feedback wording is identical across all six engines and is translatable.

pass_threshold.description: Fractional score (0..1) required to pass NON-safety scoring. Default 0.80 (ledger §C). Safety items are governed by safety_pass_threshold, not this.

safety_pass_threshold.description: Fractional score (0..1) required on the SAFETY-flagged subset. Default 0.90 (ledger §C: safety/egress/compliance content gates at >=90%).

veto_on_any_safety_failure.description: When true (the contract default and the only correct setting for safety-gated content), ANY single safety-flagged failure (a wrong safety branch, a failed safety assertion, a safety threshold breach) forces outcome=fail and sets safety_veto_triggered=true — it cannot be outscored. This mirrors 'a single safety 0 => fail' in the DB. Authors MUST NOT weaken this for safety-gated sims.

veto_feedback_i18n.description: i18n key for the veto explanation shown when a safety failure trips the hook. The wording names the real-world consequence + the fix (instant, specific, diagnostic — F5 Verdict contract). E.g. 'You trapped the occupants. A mag lock must release on power loss.'

veto_state.description: The colorblind-safe state token rendered on veto (should use token='safety_veto', shape='octagon').

xapiTelemetryEvent.title: xAPI telemetry event contract
xapiTelemetryEvent.description: The structured shape every meaningful sim interaction emits. The shared xAPI emitter (F5) queues these offline (Dexie) and flushes via the F4 sync path; the LRS bridge is M8. This is an xAPI 1.0.3-shaped statement (actor/verb/object/result/context) plus client_event_uuid for idempotent sync. It maps onto academy.sim_telemetry_events: client_event_uuid -> client_event_uuid (UNIQUE; /sync is ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, ledger §G), verb.id+object.id -> event_type, the whole statement -> payload jsonb, and result.* feeds the sim_attempts summary. This $def documents the canonical event; it is referenced by the engine schemas' example/telemetry blocks rather than embedded as required runtime data (the runtime emits these; specs declare which verbs they emit via `emits_verbs`).

client_event_uuid.description: Client-minted UUID v4. THE idempotency key (ledger §G). Maps to sim_telemetry_events.client_event_uuid (UNIQUE) and, for the attempt-summary event, sim_attempts.client_event_uuid. The same statement re-flushed after reconnect is deduped on this.

actor.description: xAPI actor — the learner. Identified by an account on the academy homepage (auth.users.id), never raw PII.

verb.description: xAPI verb (what happened). Use the ADL/xAPI vocab where it exists; the Redex profile adds 'triggered-safety-veto'.

object.description: xAPI object — the sim, node, item, or assertion acted on. id is an IRI built from sim_id + the in-spec element id.

result.description: xAPI result. Carries scoring + the safety-veto signal. result.success is the local (advisory) verdict; the authoritative mastery gate is server-side (invariant 4 — never fake a pass offline). extensions.safety_veto_triggered is the boolean that maps to sim_attempts.safety_veto_triggered.

https://academy.goredex.com/xapi/ext/saf.description: True iff a safety-flagged failure vetoed the attempt (maps to sim_attempts.safety_veto_triggered).

context.description: xAPI context: org/tenant, the sim_definition, the attempt, offline origin, and the platform manifest surface. context.extensions carries the Redex identifiers used to reconcile on /sync.

envelope.title: sim envelope
envelope.description: The embedded common header. Every engine spec includes this object under the key `envelope`.

spec_version.description: SemVer of THIS spec instance (authoring version), independent of the schema version.

sim_id.description: Stable author-facing id for this sim spec. Together with version it maps to academy.sim_definitions(key, version) (UNIQUE). lowercase, dot/dash segmented.

engine_kind.description: Which of the six engines runs this spec. MUST equal the academy.sim_kind enum value for the engine (see $defs/engineKind). The engine-specific schema additionally pins this to its own value via a const.

title_i18n.description: i18n key for the sim's display title.

competency_ids.description: Competencies this sim grades against (academy.competencies ids). At least one.

locales.description: Locales this spec's i18n keys are guaranteed to resolve in. EN is mandatory; ES is the MVP second locale.

i18n_string_keys.description: The complete set of i18n keys this spec references (the translation surface). The preview harness / CI checks every key resolves in every declared locale; the safety glossary subset is non-overridable.

scoring.description: The scoring + safety-veto hook (mirrors the DB safety rule). Required: the Verdict service reads it to compute pass/fail/veto identically across engines.

emits_verbs.description: The xAPI verb IRIs this sim's runtime emits (documents the telemetry surface; the runtime constructs full statements per $defs/xapiTelemetryEvent). MUST include the attempt lifecycle verbs.

state_tokens.description: The colorblind-safe state tokens this sim renders. The framework supplies defaults; an author may override the i18n label/shape but MUST keep shape + label non-empty (no color-only).

fixture_set_ref.description: Optional reference to a sanitized fixture set (academy.fixture_sets). Used by replay engines (device_config, panel_state_machine). A published sim may only reference a fixture with sanitized=true (DB publish-gate trigger).

offline_cacheable.description: Whether the spec + its assets are packaged into an F4 offline field pack. Telemetry still queues offline regardless (invariant 4).

$comment: This file defines reusable $defs. Engine schemas reference $defs/envelope and the other $defs by absolute $id + JSON pointer. The root object here is intentionally the envelope itself for standalone validation.
